title: Register of Antecedent Probe Holdings Act
summary: Directs the publication of a public register of interstellar probe holdings established before the Treaty, with their claimed boundaries, as an administrative clarification. Voting is open; the tally is sealed.

provisions.heading: Register
provisions.text: The Assembly Information Service shall publish a Register of Antecedent Probe Holdings listing each interstellar mission and claim established before the Treaty, its operator, target systems and claimed boundaries.

provisions.heading: Submissions
provisions.text: Operators and Council seats may submit entries. Disputed boundaries are recorded as disputed and may be referred to the Arbiter.

provisions.heading: No change in rights
provisions.text: Registration neither creates, enlarges nor diminishes any holding.

history.action: Not scheduled by the Bureau by the end of Week 2; placed on the Week 3 agenda automatically.
Division opened. Tally sealed until the window closes.
